# Route providers

Apps never name a provider. They state requirements and Gozar's catalog returns the providers that meet them.
This table lists what the registry ships. Each row is read from the provider's definition, so it is exactly
what `catalogRoutes` reports.

Gozar 0.2.0 supports Linux and macOS. On any other platform (for example Windows) every candidate answers
`unsupported`.

| Id | Name | Usage kinds | Reach | Address | Payload | SSE / streamable HTTP / OAuth DCR | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tailscale-funnel` | Tailscale Funnel | session, durable | internet | stable | endpoint only | yes / yes / yes | Free on the Personal plan (up to 6 users); Funnel is available on all plans, with non-configurable bandwidth limits. |
| `tailscale-private` | Tailscale private Serve | session, durable | tailnet | stable | unknown | yes / yes / yes | Tailscale pricing is documented, but the Serve page does not say which plans include Serve. |
| `localhost-run` | localhost.run trial | session | internet | ephemeral | provider can read | yes / yes / no | The free tier costs nothing and needs no signup; its domains change regularly and have a speed limit. |
| `lan` | Local network | session | lan | unknown | endpoint only | yes / yes / no | Gozar charges nothing and there is no provider; the owned local forwarder uses your own network. |
| `own-address` | Your own HTTPS address | session | unknown | stable | unknown | yes / yes / yes | Gozar charges nothing; your own domain, hosting and certificate cost whatever you pay for them. |
| `ngrok-https-edge` | ngrok HTTPS edge | attached | internet | stable | provider can read | yes / yes / yes | ngrok has a $0 Free plan with one development domain, but its pricing page says custom domains need Pay-as-you-go ($20 base). |
| `ngrok-tls-passthrough` | ngrok TLS passthrough | none yet | internet | unknown | endpoint only | no / no / no | The ngrok pricing page does not settle the cost of TLS passthrough. |
| `ngrok-tcp-passthrough` | ngrok TCP passthrough | none yet | internet | unknown | unknown | no / no / no | The ngrok pricing page does not settle the cost of TCP passthrough. |
| `cloudflare-named` | Cloudflare named tunnel | none yet | internet | stable | provider can read | no / no / no | Cloudflare lists a $0 Free Zero Trust plan with connector software included, but no page names Cloudflare Tunnel. |
| `tunnl-gg` | tunnl.gg trial | session | internet | stable | provider can read | yes / yes / yes | The free tier costs nothing and needs no account; Pro is $6 a month or $60 a year and removes time limits and the warning page. |
